svg.title: rm-alikes on APFS
svg.desc: Apple M4, warm cache, median of 20 runs. Higher is better. balanced-38k: remmy 60.3k files/s, xargs rm 34.9k files/s, GNU rm 27.5k files/s, bfs -delete 26.7k files/s, find -delete 25.1k files/s, /bin/rm 23.5k files/s (remmy is 2.6x faster than /bin/rm)
svg.text: Apple M4, warm cache, median of 20 runs. Higher is better.
